title: Manufacturer Sample Kits under the Ostomy Supply Program
content:
When a customer's current barrier or pouch does not fit or leaks, Larkfield may send an Ostomy Supply Program customer a no-charge manufacturer sample kit of an alternative item so the customer and their ostomy nurse can choose a new product.

**Terms of a sample.** A sample is never billed, draws no authorized units and does not count toward the allowance.

**Limit.** A sample kit is sent only while the program's sample kits over the rolling 12 months ending on the sample ship date are fewer than the tier's sample kit limit. The count is the program's sample shipments whose ship date falls within the 365 calendar days ending on and including the sample ship date being considered.

**Item.** A sample is sent only for an item eligible for the program's appliance system and ostomy type, or for the system the customer's ostomy nurse is moving them to.

**After the trial.** A product the customer chooses after a trial is supplied only after a new written order names it.

| Hypothetical case (limit of 2 kits) | Result |
|---|---|
| One sample kit shipped in the 365 days ending on the planned sample date | A further kit may be sent |
| Two sample kits shipped in that span | No further kit |
| Kit for an item eligible for the system the ostomy nurse is moving the customer to | May be sent |
| Customer chooses the sampled pouch | Supplied only after a new written order names it |
